independent_algorithm: Exhaustive coarse SE(2) likelihood-field + bounded least-squares refinement
initialization: mapping free cells on 0.4 m lattice, all orientations at 5 degrees; identical candidate array for all maps
sequential_algorithm: 2048-particle likelihood-field filter, 40 global particles per scan, local refinement; same broad first-scan search
selection: 24 equal path-distance samples plus 8 equal room-distance samples; deduplicated before matching
no_scan_deskew: Localization uses current raw scan and fixed extrinsic only; no intra-scan wheel odometry in either arm.
